findings.failing_input: userFacingError uses regex matches like /quota|429|rate ?limit/i. A new error type ('TIMEOUT', 'INVALID_PAYLOAD', etc.) falls through to the generic 'שגיאה לא צפויה' — fine. But the helper's matchers reference Google-Sheets-specific patterns ('Unable to parse range') that may not appear in current Supabase-based errors. Most errors now come from Supabase, not Sheets.
findings.expected: Add Supabase-specific matchers (e.g. 'permission denied for relation', 'connection refused').
findings.actual: Generic fallback handles unknown errors but loses specificity.
findings.fix_sketch: Add: /permission denied for relation|relation .* does not exist/i → not-found; /connection (refused|reset|terminated)|fetch failed/i → network.
findings.regression_test_idea: Pass typical Supabase error strings; assert correct Hebrew translation.

uncertainty_notes: CR-01 information-disclosure mitigation: never leak raw err.message (which contains spreadsheet IDs + service-account emails) to client. Centralized helper now used across 8 routes. Hebrew error strings are operator-friendly. Some matchers are Sheets-era leftovers (line 27 'GOOGLE_CLIENT_EMAIL' etc.) but harmless — just don't translate Supabase env errors.
